purpose: Form BEN-1 is used by an individual who is a significant beneficial owner in a reporting company to file a declaration of their significant beneficial ownership or any change therein to the reporting company.
who: Every individual who is a significant beneficial owner in a reporting company.
when: Within ninety days from the commencement of the Companies (Significant Beneficial Owners) Amendment Rules, 2019, or within thirty days of subsequently acquiring significant beneficial ownership or any change therein.
steps: Identify if there is any individual who is a significant beneficial owner in relation to the reporting company.
Cause such individual to make a declaration in Form BEN-1.
File the declaration in Form BEN-1 to the reporting company within the specified time limits.
checklist: Verify if the individual is a significant beneficial owner in the reporting company.
Check if the individual holds ultimate beneficial interest of not less than ten per cent.
Determine the exact date of commencement or the date of subsequently becoming a significant beneficial owner or undergoing a change.
watch: Not stated in the Rules text
